goal: Self-test the ordinary-chat GitHub execution infrastructure and produce auditable diagnostic evidence. Passing this self-test must never be used as proof that a user task was completed.

completionMethods.name: goal_contract_proof
completionMethods.description: The self-test request is machine-readable and bounded.

completionMethods.name: route_reachability_proof
completionMethods.description: The diagnostic relay executes in GitHub Actions without a local device.

completionMethods.name: dynamic_execution_proof
completionMethods.description: Infrastructure execution and MCP integration tests run rather than only static checks.

completionMethods.name: recovery_adversarial_proof
completionMethods.description: Infrastructure failure handling and red-team checks fail closed.

completionMethods.name: artifact_delivery_proof
completionMethods.description: Diagnostic evidence is packaged with run identity and hashes.
